bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears improved to 6-2 for the first time since 2012 after defeating the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks 34-17 on Monday night at Lumen Field. With the win fresh off their blockbuster trade for defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, the Bears are now managing a wave of injuries and roster moves, including placing Kentavius Street on IR while promoting TE Stephen Carlson from the practice squad and signing DT Earnest Brown to replace him ahead of their Week 9 matchup with Tampa Bay.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Linebacker Jack Campbell, who suffered a frightening neck injury during Detroit's Week 8 win over the Vikings, continued making encouraging progress this week, telling reporters he has "full movement in my lower body" as he recovers in the hospital. With Campbell sidelined, the Lions have bolstered their linebacker depth by promoting Joe Bachie to the active roster and signing additional linebackers as they prepare for their Week 9 road matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story is the continued buildup to Micah Parsons' return, as the Green Bay Packers are getting closer to having their best defensive player back on the field , though Green Bay is not expected to activate Parsons for Sunday's matchup against the New England Patriots, with the team targeting their Week 12 matchup against the Los Angeles Rams . vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings suffered their first loss of the season, falling 19-15 to the Detroit Lions, which sent them down the NFL power rankings , while pressure is mounting on head coach Kevin O'Connell after the offense struggled again . With the trade deadline approaching, Minnesota faces major quarterback uncertainty surrounding Kyler Murray, and reports indicate Carson Wentz is trending to start Week 9 for the Vikings .
